changes.note: Named point pack-bound-claimed-before-write: a separately-nonced ordinary other-school delivery stops after its nonce claim and before staging. Redelivery answers UNKNOWN PACK_DELIVERY_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED with no effect. The existing redelivery after withdrawal is the lost-acknowledgement COMMITTED evidence. Pinned open count for this boundary goes 1 -> 0. The prepare/target helpers take an optional suffix; the existing deliveries are unchanged. The stopped delivery's UNKNOWN redelivery raises one TARGET_UNKNOWN operator alert for other-school; the fixture's alert count goes from 9 to 10, and that alert is asserted by code and tenant. A suffixed delivery gets its own directory so the fixture's 'nothing written before commit' assertion still holds.

The open item stays open. It now cites that the reference refuses to compose qualification_target and issuer_target before reservation, signing or effect (test_unsupported_governance_composition_refuses_before_reservation_signing_or_effect), so no reference commit path exists. Scoping is for governor to rule.

Education, Health and product public authorize_release each reach ReferenceEngine.authorize_for_target -> locked_decision_transaction, which takes the tenant's regulated-evidence-v1 lock before sampling decision time. With an ordinary concurrent holder owning that lane, each release waits on that exact key; once released, its recorded decision time is at or after the release and the tenant chain stays ordered and verified. The delegated intake lane keeps its own contract.

New test: Health's public authorize_release, for a genuinely approved final record, is refused for a foreign workspace context (not allowed, no permit, nothing written). The same request in the owner's workspace is authorized. Indistinguishability stays evidenced by the existing verifier-equality test.
